topic: Redesign clean-break correction and new run spine prototype
currentUserGoal: Continue the clean-break redesign by making the run/dormancy loop more playable: Sensi is visible in desktop and compact layouts, dormancy offers permanent memory choices, and Run Touches now have an in-run emergency spend action.
changesMade: Created docs/CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md as the durable redesign spec for the new Scourge/Ancient Grass run loop.
Created docs/CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md as the chunked implementation plan with verification gates.
Added Vitest and ESLint project tooling for new-canon tests.
Removed the compatibility-graft approach that had wired Ancient HP and Run Touches into the legacy GameScene, FieldSystem, SaveSystem, and GameState.
Removed old-system baseline tests for AmountSystem, ComboSystem, and PrestigeSystem because those tests prove obsolete rules.
Added a new-canon RunSpineSystem under src/game/redesign with Ancient Grass HP, Scourge drain, touch-to-heal, effective healing, overheal, Run Touches, spend accounting, and dormancy payout math.
Added a separate RedesignPrototypeScene behind ?redesign so the first playable slice does not show the old HUD, old store, old quests, old minimap, or old field-item panel.
Updated the prototype to preserve graphical continuity by using the existing meadow background, grass tile art, dirt tile art, emerald panel frame, and fleck/spore effects.

Added the first motion/feel pass to the redesign prototype: breathing/swaying grass, root aura, Scourge tint pressure, touch camera pulse, pollen/spore bursts, dormant collapse hook, and responsive compact readouts.
Extended RunSpineSystem with a pure dormancy summary and next-run constructor so permanent memory survives while run-only values reset.

Added a visible TOUCH ROOTS affordance, periodic Scourge HP tick feedback, and an in-scene dormancy summary overlay that shows survival time, effective healing, overheal, Run Touches, and permanent Grass Touch payout.
Added Scourge root wounds: wounds open on root patches, visibly mark priority targets, increase Scourge pressure while open, clear on targeted root touch, and appear in dormancy summary stats.
Added ?redesign&fastDormancy tuning for quick loop checks.
Added a vibe-bridge pass toward the previous build: desktop Sensi panel, Run Feed panel, feed events for wounds/heals/music/new runs, and touch-unlocked playback of the existing mellow theme.
Generated a first-pass 16-bit pixel Sensi portrait from the user's reference image, copied it into public/assets/ui/characters/sensi-pixel-portrait.png, and wired it into the desktop Sensi panel.
Added Sensi presence behavior: transient event barks, mood-colored portrait frame/title states, a subtle portrait bob, a sunglasses glint, and pulse feedback when advice changes.
Added a compact Sensi communicator strip for narrower redesign layouts so the portrait and advice are visible in the in-app browser test size, while keeping Run Feed desktop-only.
Strengthened the sunglasses glint with a brighter, faster sweep and adjusted compact spacing so the Sensi strip no longer crowds the root-field prompt.
Added the first permanent memory upgrade model to RunSpineSystem: Soft Touch and Deeper Roots can be purchased with banked permanent Grass Touches and persist into future runs.
Added dormancy memory choice buttons to the redesign scene, with affordable/owned/insufficient states, Sensi barks, Run Feed entries, and next-run effects.
Applied Soft Touch as a manual healing multiplier and Deeper Roots as a max-HP/starting-HP boost on future runs.

Added Root Salve as the first Run Touch spend action: it costs 12 Run Touches, requires an active wounded root, clears one wound, heals a small amount, and keeps permanent payout based on effective healing rather than unspent Run Touches.
Wired Root Salve into the redesign HUD with active/disabled states, Sensi feedback, feed entries, root treatment effects, and click guarding so pressing the tool does not also count as a root touch.

Updated the redesign docs to say explicitly that this branch is a rebuild using old assets/concepts as raw material, not a compatibility patch, while preserving graphical/audio identity where it fits.
verification: npm run check passed after the clean-break correction: ESLint passed, Vitest passed with 1 new-canon test file and 7 tests, TypeScript compiled, and Vite built successfully.

Browser smoke at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign loaded the separate Ancient Grass: Scourge Prototype scene with existing graphical assets and no old HUD, old store, old quests, old minimap, field-item panel, or stress overlay.
Browser interaction smoke clicked the prototype root field and confirmed Run Touches increased from 0 to 6 with no warn/error console entries.
Browser motion smoke on http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign sampled 863 changed screenshot bytes across 0.8 seconds, confirming the prototype is no longer static.
After adding the dormancy summary slice, npm run check passed again and Invoke-WebRequest confirmed http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign returns status 200.
After adding Scourge wounds, npm run check passed again with 7 tests. Verify ?redesign and ?redesign&fastDormancy visually in the app before committing if possible.
After adding Sensi/feed/music presentation, npm run check passed again and both ?redesign and ?redesign&fastDormancy returned HTTP 200.

After adding the Sensi pixel portrait asset and wiring it into the panel, npm run check passed again: ESLint passed, Vitest passed with 1 file and 7 tests, TypeScript compiled, and Vite built successfully.

After adding Sensi barks and portrait animation, npm run check passed again. In-app browser smoke confirmed ?redesign ready with canvas present, no warn/error logs, and a desktop-width screenshot showing the Sensi portrait panel and Run Feed panel rendering cleanly.

After adding compact Sensi layout and strengthening the glint, npm run check passed again. In-app browser smoke at 602x788 confirmed the compact Sensi strip renders above the root field with no warn/error logs; viewport override was reset afterward.

After adding permanent memory upgrades, npm run check passed with 9 RunSpineSystem tests. In-app browser smoke on ?redesign&fastDormancy confirmed the dormancy overlay shows Soft Touch and Deeper Roots choices with no warn/error logs.

After adding Root Salve, npm run check passed with 12 RunSpineSystem tests. In-app browser smoke on ?redesign&fastDormancy clicked roots to earn Run Touches, clicked Root Salve, and confirmed a Root Salve feed entry with no warn/error logs.
In-app browser screenshot automation timed out twice during the heavier smoke after the dormancy overlay; later verification used npm run check and HTTP 200 checks.
?stress remains an old-game performance harness path and should not be used as proof of redesign progress.
currentGitStatus: Branch codex/gameplay-update has modified package-lock.json, package.json, src/main.ts, docs/CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, docs/CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md, handoffs/LATEST.json, and this handoff.

New intended files include eslint.config.js, vitest.config.ts, public/assets/ui/characters/sensi-pixel-portrait.png, src/game/redesign/RunSpineSystem.ts, src/game/scenes/RedesignPrototypeScene.ts, tests/RunSpineSystem.test.ts, and this handoff.

Pre-existing unrelated untracked files remain untouched: docs/GAME_SYSTEMS_REFERENCE CLAUDE.md, Dutch automation reference docs, docs/artifacts/title-art-2026-06-19/, docs/back of the enveloppe.md, docs/grasstouching.mid, docs/lucid.aif, and handoffs/HANDOFF_2026-06-20_POST_PUSH_WORKFLOW_TEST.json.
knownIssues: The redesign prototype is intentionally minimal and does not yet recast old saves, quests, stores, automation, companions, music, or permanent skill-tree UI.
The old game still exists in the repo and default route as obsolete reference material until replacement work proceeds.

Current ?redesign art pass reuses existing gfx/audio and now has a first Sensi portrait, but Sensi's portrait is a first-pass generated asset and should be iterated if the user wants a different likeness, crop, or palette.
The first motion pass is deliberately lightweight; it still needs authored animation direction, better Scourge art, sound, and a real first-run UX pass.
The dormancy summary overlay is functional but unpolished; it needs a designed ceremony, clearer copy, and a proper continue/restart control.
Root wounds are still a prototype mechanic: they create target priority and pressure but need better art/sound, tuned spawn cadence, and clearer tutorial copy.
Root Salve is the first in-run tool and is intentionally simple. It clears the first wounded root in the current wound list, not a player-selected target yet.
Permanent memory upgrades are prototype-only and single-rank for now: Soft Touch is +25% manual healing, Deeper Roots is +25 max HP. They are not saved across page refreshes yet.
Run Feed remains desktop-only. Sensi now has a compact strip for medium/narrow test sizes, but true phone-scale UX still needs a deliberate layout.
Music starts from the existing WAV after the first pointer interaction; proper sound settings, mute controls, and redesigned SFX are not implemented yet.
The full perf harness at ?perfHarness&tiles=1200 applies to the old game path; redesign perf gates need their own route-specific harness later.
nextRecommendedSteps: Rerun npm run check and browser-smoke http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign.
Commit the corrected clean-break Milestone 1 only after the user confirms this is the right direction.
Start the next slice by making ?redesign the real first-run experience: intro, Ancient Grass touch target, clear dormancy summary, and first permanent Grass Touch payout.
Add the next feel layer: proper Scourge visual language, healing/damage sound cues, stronger dormancy animation, and touch target affordance.
Use ?redesign&fastDormancy for quick browser checks of collapse/summary until a formal redesign harness exists.
Continue visual convergence by improving panel placement, deciding whether compact layouts need any Run Feed equivalent, and replacing prototype wound tinting with authored Scourge art.
Make the next pass connect Root Salve to clearer tutorial messaging, add a save/persistence path for permanent memory, or add a second in-run Run Touch spend action such as Dew Shield.
Give Sensi barks a proper content pass later; current lines are useful prototype flavor, not final writing.
Iterate Sensi's portrait if needed: variants should keep the bowl cut, black sunglasses, gold chain, and stern Ibiza-boss silhouette readable at small UI sizes.
When old assets return, adapt them deliberately into new-canon UI and mechanics rather than importing old systems wholesale.
doNotRevert: Do not resurrect the compatibility-graft approach that wires new meters into the old GameScene/HUD as milestone proof.
Do not conflate effective healing with overheal; Run Touches should come from effective healing only in this milestone.
Do not add tests for old systems as redesign coverage.
Do not treat the old game path or ?stress as evidence that the redesign is playable.
Do not remove public/assets/ui/characters/sensi-pixel-portrait.png unless replacing it with a deliberate Sensi portrait update.
Do not replace the new permanent upgrade model with the old skill tree/store code unless that old code is adapted into the new run/dormancy/meta contract.
Do not include unrelated local docs/media in commits unless the user specifically asks for them.
